description: Precomputed glyph metrics for one font face in font design units (unhinted, linear): Unicode-keyed advance widths, ascent/descent/line gap, units-per-em and the missing-glyph advance. Produced by TempoFontAdvanceTableExtractor from the same TTF/OTF bytes the PDF renderer embeds; code points the font has no glyph for are omitted so the JS measurer can fall back to synthetic metrics with diagnostics.
